featured_projects.title: Campunex
featured_projects.description: A geospatial campus ride-matching platform using PostgreSQL and PostGIS to match riders with drivers based on route overlap within a 500-meter proximity threshold. Features real-time GPS tracking via WebSockets and dual OTP authentication.
features: Geospatial ride-matching using PostgreSQL and PostGIS with 500m proximity threshold
Real-time GPS tracking and trip-state synchronization through WebSockets
Institutional identity verification, Redis-based geospatial caching, and dual 4-digit OTP authentication

featured_projects.title: Devnoesis
featured_projects.description: A full-stack CS learning & developer intelligence platform aggregating coding activity from GitHub, LeetCode, and Codeforces. Features DAG-based prerequisite relationships, SM-2 spaced-repetition algorithm, and a dynamic Placement Readiness Score.
features: Developer telemetry aggregating GitHub, LeetCode, and Codeforces APIs
Asynchronous API synchronization using Redis caching and BullMQ background workers
DAG-based CS knowledge graph with SM-2 spaced-repetition revision schedules
Dynamic Placement Readiness Score (0–100) in a unified Next.js dashboard

featured_projects.title: AI FanFic
featured_projects.description: An AI-powered storytelling platform supporting 3 creative modes: real-time text chat, voice-based storytelling, and image generation. Built with Google Gemini API and Web Speech API across 5+ fandom universes.
features: Google Gemini API integration with 3 creative modes: text chat, voice storytelling, and image generation
Personalized story generation across 5+ fandom universes with configurable genres
Streaming AI responses, Web Speech API voice input, and Framer Motion animations
